1 of the informant's daughter was also got terminated by the applicant.

In the statements of the victim recorded under Sections 161 and 164 CrPC, she stated that on false promise of marriage the applicant had made physical relations with her for over a period of three years.
It was also stated that the pregnancy was got terminated by the applicant.
The tentative age of the victim is 15 years and 9 months.
Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

Considering the fact that the allegations of forming physical relations, on the false pretext of marriage, allegedly continued over a span of three years and there is no material on record to corroborate the said allegations and there is no material on record to demonstrate that any operation was done to terminate a pregnancy, as alleged, a case for bail is made out, particularly when the applicant has no criminal history.
Therefore, I am of the view that the applicant, who is in jail since 06.07.2023, is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.
